# yetanother.one

> Personal project hub of Johannes Nagl — co-CEO Product at Swat.io, based in Vienna, Austria.

## About

Johannes Nagl is a dad by day, dev by night. He builds indie apps and side projects in his spare time. This site serves as a launchpad and archive for those projects.

## Projects

- [Holdor](https://holdor.app): A free, open-source native macOS menu bar app that prevents system sleep while AI agents and coding tools are running. Built with Swift. MIT licensed. Live since 2026.
- [showmd](https://showmd.app): A fast markdown viewer for macOS. In progress, 2026.
